sentences.en: The statute of limitations has already passed for this crime.
sentences.zh: 这项罪行已经超过诉讼时效了。

sentences.en: Are there limitations on the freedom of speech in Algeria?
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚言论自由有没有限制？

sentences.en: He got off because of the statute of limitations.
sentences.zh: 他因为超过了诉讼时效才获释。

senses.zh: 限制，局限性；限制因素，限度；缺点，弱点；法律限制，法定期限
